title: The Chosen Bishop
reviewNotes: Montage, captions and stable native complete later diagrams reviewed. Begin after Qf2 at 152 seconds in the complete eight-piece later diagram: White Kh2/Bc7/g2/h3 against Kh4/Qf2/g5/h5, White to move. Native images40–50 establish this phase. Bd6 and the g4/Be7+ and Qe3/g3+/Qxg3+/Bxg3# ideas are illustrated by the source. The Qf6 interposition and queen-sacrifice defense are explicitly independent completions. Every encoded larger position has an exact finite winning strategy through all opposing replies into actual mate or supported exact seven-piece leaves; every encoded supported position is tablebase checked. This proves the selected later position, not the earlier Rc2 sacrifice or every queen defense in that earlier setup. It does not mean Black must be mated immediately: Qg1+ can sacrifice the queen into a losing ending.
